verdict: NO SINGLE BRACKET, unlike the CF4 case -- det3 has two disagreeing 'measured' v_drift numbers in circulation (36.6 plan §1, 28.1+/-0.7 micro-TPC), not one tight band. The measured water fraction for the exact target run, 1.46%, predicts v=25.25 um/ns at 333 V/cm/30mm assumed -- this sits far from 36.6 (11.3 um/ns away) and moderately close to 28.1 (2.8 um/ns away, but outside the quoted +/-0.7 sigma). 1.46% water is markedly more consistent with the micro-TPC number than with the plan §1 number, though the micro-TPC number's different (~19mm) gap confounds a clean comparison. v_drift is NON-MONOTONIC in water content near this field: 0.5% H2O raises v above dry (40.6 vs 39.2 um/ns) before higher fractions drive it down -- a real Magboltz feature at this precision (per-point stat errors are sub-percent), not scan noise.
